guide.headline: Jamal Roberts ran through Missouri while Simmons carved the air
guide.hook: A 211-yard day from a bruising senior back and a clean, efficient passing clinic turned this into one of the more lopsided tape sessions of the week.

items.title: Jamal Roberts breaks the game open
items.what: Roberts came in averaging 4.4 yards a carry on the season but exploded for 211 yards on just 24 carries with three touchdowns in this one. He is a 216-pound back who already handles 32% of Missouri's team usage, and on this day his contact balance through the first tackler was the whole story. When he is hitting creases like this, there is no answer for it.
items.when: Watch his runs on early downs in the first half before Florida adjusts fronts.

items.title: Austin Simmons stays clean and accurate
items.what: Simmons finished 23 of 30 for 340 yards and two touchdowns with zero interceptions, building on a season line of 11 touchdowns against none. He is a 4-star recruit with legitimate NFL size at 6-4, 220, and his placement outside the numbers shows up on the tape as the receivers run under the ball in stride. This was a quarterback playing on schedule all day.
items.when: Look at his third-down throws, where he already carries 56% of his usage on passing downs.

items.title: Florida's deep ball vs a leaky Missouri secondary
items.what: Florida ranks No. 67 of 138 in pass explosiveness at 1.56 while Missouri ranks No. 111 of 138 in limiting explosive passes at 1.70, a 32 percentile point gap. On replay, find the first deep shot Florida takes and watch whether Missouri rolls a safety over after it connects. If that shell never changes, it explains why the big plays kept coming.
items.when: The first vertical shot of the game and how the coverage shifts afterward.

guide.cardLine: Jamal Roberts ran for 211 yards and three scores while Austin Simmons went 23 of 30 with zero picks in a near-perfect offensive day.
